events.title: KRANK| Clay trinkets
events.description: Get hands‑on with air‑dry clay as you create your own trinket dish or pair of earrings using fun tools, textures and creative designs. You’ll experiment with embossing, leaves and colourful paper to make something unique, no mess, no kilns, just easy and enjoyable clay crafting. Parents/carers required to stay for the duration of the activity.

events.description: Join artist YEAHYEAHCHLOE in this hands-on creative school holiday workshop, turning paper into playful 3D food characters. Explore a range of fun paper decorating techniques including curling, fringing, cutting, layering, and collage.

events.title: Life drawing | Figure sketching for teens
events.description: Looking for a creative way to spend your school holidays? Join us for a special teens only life drawing workshop and discover the art of drawing from a live model in a fun, relaxed, and supportive environment.

events.title: KRANK | Screen printing onto fabric
events.description: Join us this school holidays with artist and printmaker Nancy Brown to explore the art of screen printing. Learn how to create your own design, block it out on the screen, and print onto fabric!

events.title: Art 101 | Visible mending for teens
events.description: In this brief introduction to the slow art of visible mending, we will explore simple hand stitching methods for mending small holes in clothing. You will learn the methods for hand-patching and simple darning or needleweaving. Bring in some clothing with wear-spots, holes or stains that won’t budge, and with some time, patience, and a little bit of extra thread, you can give old clothes a personal touch and extend its wearability!

events.title: Family day | The many-me masterpiece
events.description: Come together as a family for a relaxed crafternoon at Logan Art Gallery. Inspired by Ripple Effect artist Xin Weng, this collaborative workshop explores the puzzle of personal identity, asking how our friends, family, and culture shape who we are.

events.title: Queensland Choral Festival 2026 A Multicultural Choral Feast
events.description: Australia is a vibrant cultural melting pot with a long history of immigration, enriching its social structure. From Indigenous peoples to waves of immigrants from Europe, Asia, and Africa, Australia thrives on its multicultural diversity, with music being one of the most powerful cultural mediums.

events.title: KRANK| Jewellery Making
events.description: Learn how to twist and shape coiled wire and crystals into beautiful handmade jewellery. You’ll get creative, make something sparkly and unique and enjoy a relaxing craft session in the peaceful surroundings of Mayes Cottage.
